_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' Grand Theft Auto Connected egg (MIT).
name: GTA Connected
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A scriptable multiplayer mod for GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas, Liberty City Stories and GTA IV. Installs the server version you choose and starts the free roam resource.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GTA Connected. Downloads the Linux server for the node's CPU from
# gtaconnected.com. server.xml and your resources are never overwritten;
# the server's own files are only replaced once the download is complete.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

want="${DL_VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) flavour=Linux latest=linux ;;
aarch64) flavour=Linux-ARM64 latest=linux-arm64 ;;
*) fail "GTA Connected has no server for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

site=https://gtaconnected.com/downloads/server
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    # The latest download redirects to the versioned file.
    loc=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$site/latest/$latest/") || fail "gtaconnected.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    version=$(sed -n "s/.*GTAC-Server-$flavour-\([0-9][0-9.]*\)\.tar\.gz$/\1/p" <<<"$loc")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "gtaconnected.com didn't say which version is the latest. Reinstall to try again."
else
    version="$want"
fi
file="GTAC-Server-$flavour-$version.tar.gz"
code=$(curl -sS --retry 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I "$site/$file") || fail "gtaconnected.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "GTA Connected has no version $version for this CPU. Set Version to latest, or to a version such as 1.7.3."

if [ -x Server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-gtac 2>/dev/null)" = "$file" ]; then
    echo "GTA Connected $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading GTA Connected $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/server.tar.gz" "$site/$file" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir "$build/x"
    tar -xzf "$build/server.tar.gz" -C "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/Server" ] || fail "The download didn't contain the server. Reinstall to try again."
    # The server and its libraries replace the old ones; the example
    # settings and resources are only added where there are none.
    find "$build/x" -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name server.xml -exec cp -f {} /mnt/server/ \;
    [ -f server.xml ] || cp "$build/x/server.xml" server.xml
    mkdir -p resources
    cp -rn "$build/x/resources/." resources/ 2>/dev/null || true
    chmod +x Server
    echo "$file" > .raptor-gtac
fi
echo "Installed GTA Connected $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The server version to install, such as 1.7.3, or latest.

variables.name: Game
variables.description: The game players connect from: gta:iii, gta:vc, gta:sa, gta:ug (Liberty City Stories), gta:iv or gta:eflc.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true lists the server in the server browser, false keeps it unlisted.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty lets anyone join.
